license_verification: CC0-1.0 link verified on each primary source page; public redistribution and modification permitted. Source and page hashes retained.
preview_policy: Freesound public HQ preview URLs were exposed in primary page HTML. No login or private original download endpoint was used.
validation: Decoded all four outputs, checked format, finite samples, duration and peak level; checked motor loop boundary against interior sample differences. Both door outputs are exactly 70560 decoded samples / 1600 ms; unchanged asset hashes are verified on partial preparation runs.
limitations: No auditory review or in-game playback was performed. Neutrality, lack of incidental voices and perceptual seam quality require human listening.
Freesound files are lossy public MP3 previews re-encoded to Vorbis; the original WAVs were not downloaded.
Motor is a 3.75-second loop made from a short real approaching-motor segment; real recording ambience remains.
Arrival is a short mechanical library-elevator bell excerpt; the door portion of that source is excluded.
Door recordings are shortened with pitch-preserving atempo to match the 1600 ms door movement; motion texture can change despite preserved pitch.
